title.zh: Pascal K. Douglas：时尚电影的主角是人
title.en: Pascal K. Douglas on Fashion Films That Put People First

summary.zh: ASVOFF 18 开幕之夜，评委 Pascal K. Douglas 与 C33 谈起这一届短片里的个人故事，以及他判断一部时尚电影时真正看重的东西。
summary.en: At the opening of ASVOFF 18, juror Pascal K. Douglas tells C33 why the season’s short films are looking beyond clothes—and what makes a story stay with him.

body.zh:
第 18 届 ASVOFF 在巴黎 Dover Street Market Paris 开幕当晚，C33 与评委 Pascal K. Douglas 谈了这一届的短片。他看到的变化很明确：影片不再一味把服装放在画面中心，而是把镜头转向穿衣服的人。家庭、历史、个人成长，在时尚行业里如何立足，以及人与自然的关系，都进入了他看过的作品。服装仍在其中，只是有了服务故事的位置。

谈到年轻的中国创作者，Douglas 想起郭培为 Rihanna 制作、曾在 Met Gala 上亮相的礼服。他以此说明中国的文化与时尚有丰富的表达空间；给新导演的建议，则是从自己的文化、经历及与时尚的关系出发，把要说的事讲得具体。

评审一部时尚电影，他会看摄影、制作、表演和声音。但这些部分需要一起工作。音乐、表演与叙事互相支撑时，影片才能把观众带进另一个世界。片长不是尺度：短片或长片，只要故事足够有力，都可能留下印象。

[ASVOFF 18 官方评委名单](https://www.ashadedviewonfashionfilm.com/asvoff-18)
body.en:
On the opening night of ASVOFF 18 at Dover Street Market Paris, C33 spoke to juror Pascal K. Douglas about the films he had seen. His observation was specific: this year’s shorts seemed less concerned with clothes as spectacle than with the people wearing them. Family, history, personal growth, survival in the fashion industry and our relationship with nature all surfaced in the work. Fashion was present, but it did not have to carry the story alone.

Asked what he would tell young filmmakers in China, Douglas brought up Rihanna’s Guo Pei gown at the Met Gala. For him, it was a reminder of the range of Chinese fashion and cultural history. His advice was to work from one’s own culture, experience and relationship with fashion—and to be precise about what one wants to say.

As a juror, Douglas looks at cinematography, production, performance and sound. None operates in isolation. He is drawn to films in which music, acting and narrative come together and take the viewer somewhere. Duration is beside the point: a short film can command attention when its story does.

[ASVOFF 18 official jury](https://www.ashadedviewonfashionfilm.com/asvoff-18)

title.zh: Eric Daman 谈 ASVOFF：让作品被看见，也要继续投下去
title.en: Eric Daman on Why Filmmakers Should Keep Submitting

summary.zh: 服装设计师 Eric Daman 在 ASVOFF 18 开幕现场与 C33 谈电影节的变化、年轻创作者如何进入，以及他参与的电影《Peter Hujar’s Day》。
summary.en: At ASVOFF 18, costume designer Eric Daman speaks to C33 about the festival’s reach, the value of trying again, and his work on Peter Hujar’s Day.

body.zh:
Dover Street Market Paris 成为第 18 届 ASVOFF 的举办场地。开幕之夜，服装设计师 Eric Daman 告诉 C33，这一合作让电影节获得更广的能见度，也让更多业内人士注意到它。对他而言，规模扩大之所以有意义，是因为年轻创作者因此有更多机会接触到原本难以进入的资源。

谈到想把作品送进电影节的新导演，Daman 给出的建议很直接：把片子投出去，尽可能参加不同的电影节。一次没有入选，不意味着作品没有下一次机会。他鼓励创作者继续尝试，明年再投。

采访临近结束时，Daman 提到自己参与的独立电影《Peter Hujar’s Day》。这部由 Ira Sachs 执导、以摄影师 Peter Hujar 为题材的影片，署名 Daman 与 Khadija Zeggaï 共同负责服装设计。

[ASVOFF 18 官方评委名单](https://www.ashadedviewonfashionfilm.com/asvoff-18) · [《Peter Hujar’s Day》影片资料](https://fest.afi.com/2025/luminaries-2025/peter-hujars-day/)
body.en:
Dover Street Market Paris is hosting the 18th edition of ASVOFF. Speaking to C33 on opening night, costume designer Eric Daman said the setting had brought the festival greater visibility and more attention from the industry. What matters to him about that growth is the access it can offer young filmmakers who might otherwise struggle to reach those circles.

For directors hoping to enter festivals, his advice was plain: send the work out, try every festival that makes sense, and keep going if this year brings no selection. A film that misses one edition may find its place in the next.

Before the conversation ended, Daman pointed readers to Peter Hujar’s Day, the independent film on which he worked. Directed by Ira Sachs, it centres on the photographer Peter Hujar and credits Daman alongside Khadija Zeggaï for costume design.

[ASVOFF 18 official jury](https://www.ashadedviewonfashionfilm.com/asvoff-18) · [Peter Hujar’s Day film details](https://fest.afi.com/2025/luminaries-2025/peter-hujars-day/)
